context: Today any layout-extras file marks its repo as rolled out. degen and mailaudit already hold one, with a waiting-page key and no visit, so lint/layout.py reads them as rolled out. This was item 29 on the old page; its answer, if you gave one, is on your other account.
holds: o8 lane (c) and c132 (repo branding) wait: both add keys to this file.

options.gain: Repos can carry page keys before their visit; degen and mailaudit read right.
options.how: The file gains a rolled-out field; other keys (waiting page, colour, icon) no longer imply a visit.
options.label: A separate rolled-out mark
options.lose: One more field to set at each visit.

options.how: degen and mailaudit get their visit, or their files move aside until then.
options.label: Keep it: the file means rolled out
options.lose: No repo can hold a page key before its visit.

title: What marks a repo as rolled out in .claude/layout-extras.json
why: It was the advisor's pick on item 29, and it unblocks two steps without touching child repos.
